title: Privacy
headline: Share only what you need to.
description: This page explains how this website handles information.

sections.title: Browsing and preferences
sections.text: This static website contains no analytics or advertising scripts. The hosting provider may process connection logs. A theme preference is stored in your browser only when available; it is not an account or a tracking identifier.

sections.title: Case checker
sections.text: The checker uses fixed choices in the current page. It has no upload field and does not automatically submit or store your answers. Reloading clears the selection.

sections.title: Choosing a contact channel
sections.text: A WhatsApp or email link opens an external service with the message you choose to prepare. That provider processes the information you send according to its own practices. Keep passwords, one-time codes and identity numbers out of the first enquiry.

sections.title: Before sending documents
sections.text: Ask who will access files, why they are required, how they will be transferred and the applicable retention and deletion arrangements. This site does not operate a document vault or promise a particular email retention period.

sections.title: Questions and requests
sections.text: Contact info@salaroutsourcing.com for privacy questions or access and deletion enquiries. Describe your request without attaching additional sensitive documents unnecessarily.
